I noticed one of the devnet-8 buildoor instances is practically non-functional at the moment. Specifically the https://api-buildoor-nimbus-erigon-1.srv.glamsterdam-devnet-8.ethpandaops.io/ instance. It responds extremely slowly (>1s) to direct get-bid requests, and when it does, it is always a 204 - no bid available. It has produced 0 bids total.

Based on the logs I am guessing it is not receiving `payload_attributes` SSE events from the Nimbus CL. AFAICT Nimbus added support for this topic a couple months ago so this *should* work.
